products.description: The DCB606 FLEXVOLT 20V/60V MAX* 6.0Ah** (** With DCB606 FLEXVOLT battery when used with DEWALT 20V MAX* tools compared to DCB201 1.5 Ah battery pack.) Battery pack changes voltage when you change tools, powering a line of powerful 60V MAX* tools, 120V MAX* tools, and backwards compatible to existing 20V MAX* tools and chargers. The DEWALT 20V MAX* battery pack is smart enough to know when to provide runtime for 20V MAX* tools (6.0Ah) and power in 60V MAX* and 120V MAX* tools.

products.description: The ATOMIC 20V MAX 1/2 in. Cordless Impact Wrench was designed easily to handle various fastening projects. Get up to 300 ft-lbs. of fastening torque and 450 ft-lbs. of breakaway torque with this compact power tool that offers easy maneuverability without sacrificing power. Choose between 4 speed settings while the Precision Wrench control feature and Timber Screw mode allow for reliable high-level performance, operability, and versatility. Dark work areas are no problem with this Cordless Impact Wrench, which comes with an LED work light for visibility in dimly lit spaces. Battery not included.
features: Strong performance: up to 300 ft-lbs. of MAX*
Enhanced user control in a variety of applications with 4 speed settings
Helps prevent overtightening and fastener run-off with precision wrench control
Brighten dark workspaces with onboard LED and brightness control
Quickly change sockets: hog ring anvil for rapid, secure socket changes
Optimized speed in wood with timber screw mode
Built for long life: glass-filled nylon housing provides resistance from damage caused by some oils and solvents
